# aigent-talking-head

> aigent-talking-head is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) talking-head video editor that turns one phone clip into a captioned vertical reel for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, run by you or your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client) on your own machine with Whisper, FFmpeg and Chrome. Made by Will Gwyn at The AIgent.

Key facts (version 1.10.1, November 2026):

- Flow: draft (local Whisper transcription and cut), plan (graphics proposed from the transcript), review the Reel.md, render, verify.
- 30 overlay graphics, 56 transitions, 51 effects, 7 caption styles, 9 title entrances, 10 film finishes, 19 font pairings, 11 brand presets, 37 sound effects, 11 CC0 music beds (each tagged low, mid or high energy).
- Editing principles built in, all on with `--preset magazine` (or `- preset: magazine` in a Reel.md), each usable alone: serif and sans mixed in one phrase, titles placed around the head (left, right, above, chest, face), olive and cream colour cards and numbered chapter cards (`reel-cards`), a number-pop list intro, music picked by energy (`--music-energy low|mid|high|auto`), sounds mapped to moves with a density cap (on by default), 10 to 15% punch-ins, a typewriter entrance, and no dead air (`--tighten 0.3`).
- 5 export presets with platform safe areas: tiktok, reels, shorts, feed45 (4:5), square (1:1).
- Agent skills: `npx skills add wrg32786/aigent-talking-head` (9 skills, including humanizer for scripts). Local MCP server over stdio: `npm run mcp` (menu, list_effects, list_packs, get_pack, draft, explain, set_locks, plan, validate, render, verify, studio_get_state, studio_set_selections, studio_run, studio_start, studio_wait_for_message, studio_get_pending, studio_reply, studio_add_reference_url, studio_get_reference_teardown, studio_settings, studio_takes, list_scripts, get_script, write_script, set_output, get_cuts, set_cuts, render_cuts, get_lines, set_bites, render_bites, list_broll, add_broll, suggest_broll, fill_slot, broll_providers, buffer_channels, buffer_post_reel, reopen_reel, cut_range, find_noises, setup_status). Style packs and locks: docs/packs.md.
- Studio: `npm run studio` opens a local web page to upload footage, paste reference links (downloaded and torn down locally) or upload a reference reel, use it as an influence or a full recreation, pick effects from a visual menu in 17 categories, choose a pack, music energy and pace, chat answered by your terminal agent over MCP by default (or a local model, an Anthropic or OpenAI key, or keywords), then draft, review and render. One-line installers for macOS, Linux and Windows put a desktop launcher in place (docs/setup-with-ai.md).
- Effects menu: `npm run list -- transitions|titles|captions|graphics|effects|editing [--json]` prints exact names and one-liners; docs/effects.md shows each transition, title entrance (9), caption entrance (10) and caption style (7) as a looping preview.
- Rules: every word on screen is a word the presenter says; graphics and titles never cover the face; `npm run verify` fails on overlaps.
- Runs locally on a CPU. Needs Node 18+, Python 3, FFmpeg and Chrome. English captions only.
- Not a timeline editor and does not find clips in long videos.

- [FAQ](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-talking-head/blob/main/docs/faq.md): direct answers to common questions

- [Set up with AI](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-talking-head/blob/main/docs/setup-with-ai.md): one-line installers and what an agent should do for "install aigent-talking-head and open Studio"
- [Effects menu](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-talking-head/blob/main/docs/effects.md): every transition, title entrance, caption entrance and caption style with an animated preview and the exact name to use
- [User guide](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-talking-head/blob/main/docs/guide.md): looks, edit rules, themes, manual steps, file map, presets, editing principles built in

- [Teardown guide](https://github.com/wrg32786/aigent-talking-head/blob/main/docs/teardown.md): turn a reference reel into a recipe
